pythonFunction.name: get_account_number_masked
pythonFunction.description:
Returns the account number in masked form showing only the last 4 digits. This is the only form
of the account number that may be spoken or shown. Needs an identified caller. Before calling
this tool, speak a brief conversational pacing phrase while it runs.

Args:
    account_id: Account id of the identified account (REQUIRED).
    tenant: Injected by the system from tenant_id; leave empty.

Returns:
    dict with ok and masked_account_number, for example XXXX-XXXX-1234.
